tutorial.title: Python Dependencies
tutorial.descriptionContent: Transfer package installation and version-management skills to harder interleaved tasks.
tutorial.shortDescriptionContent: Python learners who want additional dependency practice

lessons.title: Find Another Standard Module
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which module comes with Python's standard library?

mathrequestsnumpytabulate

Make sure to pick math.

lessons.title: Predict a Release Impact
lessons.interactiveContent:
A dependency is unpinned and releases a breaking change. What can happen when the project is installed later?

The project can receive changed behaviorpip must install the old tested releaseThe dependency becomes part of the standard libraryrequirements.txt stops listing dependencies

The project can receive changed behavior.

lessons.title: Recover a Missing Library
lessons.interactiveContent:
A new environment raises ModuleNotFoundError for the third-party package requests. Which action directly prepares that environment?

Run pip install requestsRun import requests in the terminalInstall the standard-library module mathPin requests without installing it

Run pip install requests.

lessons.title: Pin the Table Package
lessons.interactiveContent:
A report must use exact tabulate version 0.8.10. Which requirement fits?

tabulate==0.8.10tabulate>=0.8tabulate<1tabulate

Make sure to pick tabulate==0.8.10.

lessons.title: Compare Two Environments
lessons.interactiveContent:
Environment A has tabulate installed, but environment B doesn't. Which statement is accurate?

Environment B must install tabulate before importing itEnvironment B automatically shares A's installed packagesInstalling tabulate in A adds it to Python's standard libraryEnvironment B can import tabulate by repeating the import

Environment B must install tabulate before importing it.

lessons.title: Read an Inclusive Lower Bound
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which candidate satisfies this requirement?

Version 2.30Version 2.29Only versions below 2.30No version is specified

Version 2.30.

lessons.title: Select the Dependency List
lessons.interactiveContent:
math is from the standard library. tabulate and requests are installed packages. Which file records only third-party dependencies?

tabulaterequestsmathtabulaterequestspip install tabulateimport requests

Make sure to pick tabulaterequests.

lessons.title: Choose an Update Policy
lessons.interactiveContent:
A prototype should accept fixes after version 0.8 but avoid version 1. Which requirement matches that policy?

tabulate>=0.8,<1tabulate==0.8tabulate>=1tabulate

Make sure to pick tabulate>=0.8,<1.

lessons.title: Add the Missing Dependency
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which requirements file keeps the exact tabulate release and adds requests?

tabulate==0.8.10requeststabulaterequestsmathtabulate==0.8.10pip install requests

Make sure to pick tabulate==0.8.10requests.

lessons.title: Interpret an Upper Bound
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which version is excluded by this requirement?

Version 1.0Version 0.9Version 0.8Every version below 1

Version 1.0.

lessons.title: Rebuild the Project Environment
lessons.interactiveContent:
Complete the option that installs the project dependencies from requirements.txt.

Make sure to pick -r.

lessons.title: Compare a Pin and a Range
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which requirement guarantees the same tested requests release in every recreated environment?

requests==2.32.3requests>=2.30requests<3requests

Make sure to pick requests==2.32.3.

lessons.title: Sequence the Project Setup
lessons.interactiveContent:
A cloned project already contains requirements.txt. Which action comes before running code that imports its packages?

Install the listed requirementsImport every package before installationDelete the requirements fileAssume the active environment already matches

Install the listed requirements.

lessons.title: Join Compatible Bounds
lessons.interactiveContent:
Complete the bounded rule that allows version 2.30 or newer while staying below version 3.

Make sure to pick >=2.30, followed by ,, and finally <3.

lessons.title: Filter Standard Modules
lessons.interactiveContent:
tabulate, requests, and numpy are third-party packages. Which import uses Python's standard library?

import randomimport tabulateimport requestsimport numpy

import random.

lessons.title: Choose Safe Boundaries
lessons.interactiveContent:
The project can use tabulate updates from version 0.8 but must stay below version 1. Which rule states that goal directly?

tabulate>=0.8,<1tabulate==0.8tabulate>=1tabulate

Make sure to pick tabulate>=0.8,<1.

lessons.title: Debug a New Environment
lessons.interactiveContent:
The third-party package tabulate works in environment A, but a fresh environment B raises ModuleNotFoundError. Why?

Environment B doesn't have the dependency installedtabulate became part of the standard libraryThe import must run before installationBoth environments always share installed packages

Environment B doesn't have the dependency installed.

lessons.title: Change the Version Rule
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which rule allows requests version 2.30 or newer while excluding version 3?

requests>=2.30,<3requests==2.32.3requests>=3requests<2.30

Make sure to pick requests>=2.30,<3.

lessons.title: Install a New Package
lessons.interactiveContent:
Complete the command that installs the third-party package numpy.

Make sure to pick pip, followed by install, and finally numpy.

lessons.title: Check the Range Edge
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which candidate is outside this accepted range?

Version 3.0Version 2.31Version 2.30Version 2.99

Version 3.0.

lessons.title: Audit the Dependency File
lessons.interactiveContent:
random is a standard-library module, and numpy is an installed package. Which dependency list is correct?

numpyrandomnumpyrandompip install numpy

Make sure to pick numpy.

lessons.title: Choose a Deliberate Update
lessons.interactiveContent:
A team wants fixes within version 2 but plans to review version 3 separately. Which requirement supports that decision?

requests>=2.30,<3requests>=3requestsrequests==3

Make sure to pick requests>=2.30,<3.

lessons.title: Prepare Before Importing
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which setup lets a new environment run code that imports every listed dependency?

Install requirements.txt with pip, then run the Python importsRun the imports, then ask pip to read requirements.txtCopy only the import statements into requirements.txtInstall the standard library with pip

Install requirements.txt with pip, then run the Python imports.

lessons.title: Make the Final Version Choice
lessons.interactiveContent:
A one-time analysis must reproduce exact results from numpy version 2.5.2. Which rule is the best fit?

numpy==2.5.2numpy>=2.5.2numpy<3numpy

Make sure to pick numpy==2.5.2.
